notes.title: Update News (11/07/2018)
notes.notes:
Update 1 - 11/07/2018

Hey guys, today we're releasing the first patch for Detective Gallo!

Remember that savegames are not compatible across versions, but if you were in the middle of playing the game at the time of the update, you can switch to the previous version (PubRelease_June) through the betas tab.

What's new?

 French Localization 
You can finally play the game in French from today! Hourra!

Autosave 
At a key point of the game (the dumpster), a savegame will be automatically taken to prevent a bug in the final part of the game. You can access the autosave from the load game screen.

Bug Fixes 
. Fixed a bug for which Gallo doesn't receive the red ball automatically in the "Edi&Son" sequence.
. Various improvements/optimizations needed
